title: Plinko X

sourceFacts: The official non-Classic Plinko X LOW screen shows16 peg rows,17 buckets, pink1x/yellow5x/blue10x legend, VersionLOW/MEDIUM/HIGH and ball Amount1/5/10/25. Twenty LOW single-ball debits/results/credited balances were verified. Later read-only rendered-caption inspection verified Medium/High bucket tables without further wagers.
unresolved: All three17-bucket tables are verified from rendered captions/screenshots. Only LOW single-ball outcomes were directly played; Medium/High outcomes remain unobserved.
Paths, color selection and atomic total-stake batch settlement are independent operator choices; native multi-ball accounting was not played.
Provider probabilities, exact artwork/audio, recovery and complete parity remain unverified.
